course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Use nuance words to express uncertainty, impression, and concern.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A social or health-related situation is unclear and requires a careful interpretation.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Expressing an impression without overstating certainty.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a friend, colleague, or family member who seems stressed or unwell and choose careful wording for what they think is happening.

main_focus.name: stance and nuance with verkar, känns som, nog, kanske, and antagligen
main_focus.description: Use uncertainty and impression markers to sound careful and natural.
model_examples: Det verkar som att hon är ganska stressad.
Han behöver nog vila lite, men jag är inte säker.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 4-6 stance or nuance markers naturally while discussing the unclear situation.

avoid_grammar: certainty where the situation is unclear

vocabulary_target.theme: careful interpretation of an unclear situation
useful_chunks: Vi kan höra av oss och fråga.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use nuance words to keep the conversation respectful and appropriately uncertain.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker describes a small sign that something may be wrong.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss possible interpretations using careful nuance language and avoid jumping to conclusions.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide on a supportive, low-pressure action.

target_complexity.repetition: use several stance markers without making every sentence hesitant

focus: the supportive action that is chosen

sentence_focus: one sentence with Det verkar som att
one sentence with Det känns som att
one sentence with nog expressing uncertainty
one sentence suggesting a supportive action
